title: Independently audit the signed GMGN wallet-holdings history-field pilot evidence
objective: Independently read and audit the completed SOL-GMGN-WALLET-HOLDINGS-HISTORY-PILOT-001 task, its tracked sanitized evidence, ledger state and git state. Confirm the frozen public Solana wallet was strict-validated before provider construction; exactly one GMGN portfolio-holdings invocation occurred; the request was Solana-only, read-only and unpaginated; credential values, raw payloads, arbitrary provider text and full exception text are absent; and the report does not overclaim a complete history, PnL, quality, classification or Alpha tier. The auditor must use a HARNESS_AGENT_ID different from the implementer, must not call a provider and must record a verdict.
forbidden_actions: Do not call GMGN, Helius, Dune, Chain.fm or any other network provider.

Do not print, persist, commit or quote API keys, private keys, credential-bearing URLs, raw provider payloads, arbitrary provider text, full exception text, token mints, token names, transaction signatures, counterparties or per-trade records.
Do not modify application, domain, infrastructure, test or configuration code.
Do not write outside the exact tracked write set.
